name: Waifu: The School
source:
A regular school day turns out to be something more.
I met a bunch of awesome people on my first day, but someone is not who they say they are.  Someone from the future is after me, but there may be more to it than this.

[From [url=https://introdreamarts.itch.io/waifu-the-school]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
原本平常的上学日，竟有了意想不到的发展。
入学第一天，我认识了一群很棒的人，但其中有人隐瞒了自己的真实身份。有个来自未来的人在追踪我，而事情或许远没有这么简单。

[摘自[url=https://introdreamarts.itch.io/waifu-the-school]Itch.io[/url]]
